system_boundary: Post-compensation waveform coding. The benchmark measures payload for residual records reconstructed by software. It does not measure ADC acquisition power, MCU execution time, or hardware energy.
selection_boundary: For each codec and target, retain only predeclared candidates with a proven worst-case packet bound no greater than the target. Fixed-configuration uniform, PCA, and Haar candidates use the closest proven bound. Bounded-SoD uses healthy-validation mean payload closest to the target; payload ties use lower code-domain reconstruction MSE on 8 chronologically evenly spaced healthy-validation records, then frozen candidate order. No labels or test records are used.
payload_capacity_contract: At every target, every serialized healthy and damaged record packet must be no larger than the target. SoD reserves an equal per-path packet cap including its timestamp/level framing and stops only at an event boundary; a decoder then holds the final transmitted level.
